overall: The AG found the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by not responding within 10 days to a request, made to the Chair, for open-session minutes; the Council had already released the minutes, and the matter was resolved by informal action with a compliance order.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Council failed to respond within 10 days to a February 1 request, sent to the Chair, for all open-session minutes for 2024 through 2026.
allegations.key_passage: The Council acknowledges, and we find, that the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to respond to the February 1 request for minutes within 10 days.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Council’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
